services.name: River Sightseeing Cruise
services.desc: Best Birding and Viewing the Nature Coast of Florida! 3 Hours About The River Cruise departs twice daily and provides a great opportunity for birding and viewing the Nature Coast of Florida. While on the cruise keep your eye out for wild pigs, deer, river otters, dolphins and of course - manatees. There is a wide variety of birds: several types of herons (great blue, blue, green, golden crown night, etc.), egrets, hawks, eagles, osprey, roseate spoonbills, anhingas, cormorants, and Private for up to 6 • 3 Hours • Explore the beautiful Florida coast!

services.name: Swim With Gentle Manatees and Rainbows
services.desc: Swim with the gentle manatees! 8 Hours About You will get to experience the two best attractions/tours in the area. You will start with a Deluxe Manatee tour break for lunch and then explore scenic Rainbow River. You will get to view some of the best of Florida's Nature Coast. You will have a boat tour of the area, swim with manatees and later snorkel or scuba down Rainbow river. Along the way you may see, deer, pigs, otters, dozens of birds, turtles, manatees, alligator gars, and more. Certified SCUBA divers can dive down Rainbow otherwise you may snorkel it. Highlights Spend a day 8 Hours

services.name: Become a Mermaid for the Day - Try Mermaid
services.desc: 2 Hours About The SSI Try Mermaid program is your introduction to the world of mermaids and mermen and to swimming with a mermaid monofin. This entry-level program gives you the opportunity to experience the underwater world in a confined water setting. You will earn the SSI Try Mermaid recognition rating under the supervision of a SCUBA School International certified Mermaid 2 Hours Mermaid Experience.

services.name: Rainbow River Drift Dive
services.desc: 4 Hours About Makes a great family activity, since divers and non-divers can participate together. The Rainbow River in Dunnellon, Florida is known for its pristine beauty and natural conditions. The facilities include a boat ramp, changing room, and small beach. You will enter the Rainbow River and then drift dive with your guide down-stream. There are numerous small caverns, boils, and popcorn springs along the way. There are several different kinds of fresh water fish such as bass, brim, and gar that live in the waters. Combine with a morning manatee tour or you can book this dive 4 Hours

We also have a larger boat for a party of up to 10 people What to bring: yourself, any snacks or refreshments you like, and your sense of adventure! When to arrive: please arrive at the shop 30 minutes before your scheduled All Ages · 2 - 2.5 Hours · Private for 6 or 10 per boat

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Take in the Sunset Around Crystal River! For just a few select weekends, we’re offering sunset cruises around Crystal River and our surrounding waterways. Join us on a semi-private or private cruise with your family and friends. Or make it a romantic evening and bring your own champagne or wine and toast with your loved one as the sun slips down over the bay. Come celebrate the Manatee Festival in January and Valentine’s Day in February with us on these special cruises. But hurr Weather GUARANTEE! If we need to cancel the tour due to unsafe weather, we will reschedule another time. If another 2.5 Hours • 6 People per Boat

services.name: Captain’s Charter Half and Full Day
services.desc: Choose your own adventure with a captain to take you around Crystal River’s waterways for either a half or full day. 5 or 8 hours About Your adventure includes an option for lunch at one of the restaurants on King’s Bay (lunch cost not included). Explore our springs, go snorkeling, swim with some manatees, see the wildlife, and so much more! You can request to dock at the fish & wildlife museum, head out to the Gulf of Mexico, explore Sandy Hook, and get to know Crystal River like never before. Tours start at 9AM daily and run year-round. Call us to choose from the following Half or Full day options
